units.source_text: 天色向晚，大家准备回家。

en.t: As evening drew on, everyone prepared to go home.

units.source_text: 此时群花零落，暮霭苍茫。

en.t: By then the flowers had fallen in drifts, and the dusk haze stretched dimly into the distance.

units.source_text: 内大臣回忆往事，慨然吟咏，姿态甚是潇洒。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior recalled the past and recited verses with deep feeling, cutting a most elegant figure.

units.source_text: 夕雾面对凄凉的暮景，悠然神往。

en.t: Yugiri gazed at the lonely evening scene and let his thoughts drift away in quiet reverie.

units.source_text: 旁人嚷着“天要下雨了”，

en.t: People nearby were calling out, "It is going to rain,"

units.source_text: 但他如同不闻，依然耽于沉思。

en.t: but he seemed not to hear them and remained lost in thought.

units.source_text: 内大臣睹此情状，想是忍不住了，

en.t: Seeing him in this state, the Minister of the Interior seemed unable to hold back any longer,

units.source_text: 拉着夕雾的衣袖，对他言道：

en.t: and he took Yugiri by the sleeve and said to him:

units.source_text: “你为何如此怪我？

en.t: "Why do you blame me so much?

units.source_text: 今天同来祭扫，请看太君面上，恕我往日之罪吧。

en.t: Since we have come together today to pay our respects at the grave, please forgive my past offense for the late lady's sake.

units.source_text: 我年已向晚，余命无多。

en.t: My own life is already nearing its evening, and little time remains to me.

units.source_text: 若见弃于人，真乃遗恨无穷了！”

en.t: If I were abandoned by others now, it would leave me with endless regret!"

units.source_text: 夕雾闻言，不胜惶恐，答道：

en.t: Hearing this, Yugiri was overcome with awe and answered:

units.source_text: “小甥秉承外祖母遗志，本当仰仗舅父栽培，

en.t: "As your humble nephew, I should have followed my grandmother's wishes and relied on my uncle's guidance,

units.source_text: 只因获罪未蒙原宥，故而未敢前来领教。”

en.t: but because I had offended you and had not yet received your forgiveness, I did not dare come to seek your instruction."

units.source_text: 此时风雨大作，势甚凶猛。

en.t: Just then the wind and rain broke out fiercely, with tremendous force.

units.source_text: 诸人争先恐后，纷纷散归。

en.t: Everyone hurried to leave, each trying to get away before the others, and they scattered homeward.

units.source_text: 夕雾返家之后，独自寻思：

en.t: After Yugiri returned home, he thought to himself:

units.source_text: “内大臣今天对我态度与往常不同，

en.t: "The Minister of the Interior treated me differently today than he usually does,

units.source_text: 不知他心中有何打算。”

en.t: and I do not know what he has in mind."

units.source_text: 他日夜思念云居雁，故凡她家之事，即使极小，亦甚关心。

en.t: Because he thought of Kumoi no Kari day and night, he cared deeply about anything concerning her family, however small it might be.

units.source_text: 这天晚上他左思右想，直到天明。

en.t: That night he turned the matter over and over in his mind until dawn.
